validity.recommendation: Re-state the row as the offshore export line (riser block to Kalmykia landfall); EndLocation Budyonnovsk is the onshore destination of the gas, not the terminus of the 114 km pipe. Consider whether an onshore Kalmykia-Budyonnovsk line is missing.
validity.researcher_notes: 114 km / 28 in are confirmed by Offshore Technology and Saipem, but both describe the OFFSHORE gas export pipeline from the RB platform to the Kalmykia landfall, not a line reaching Budyonnovsk. The row's end (Budyonnovsk, Stavropol Krai) therefore mixes the offshore section with the gas destination. Existence OK (real Saipem-built line). Classification 'gathering' is plausible for a field export line (flag only). Diameter 28 in is correct as stated in inches (711 mm); mm figure not given by a document, not converted.
